about_the_game:
Courier: Dragons Within is a 2D/3D Character Narrative Experience about self-forgiveness. Play as Chase, an irascible young man fresh from a string of broken relationships, as he follows Tag, a professional dragon seeker, through the remote paths of Big Sur National Park in search of a cave that grants wishes. With the curses of his father and the echos of his last best friend pursuing him in his waking hours, confronting the mythic in the wilderness may offer him a new definition of being a man.

  • Featuring three novel, nonviolent verbs: from wandering and wading through your memories as you traverse labyrinths in mediation, to using your controller to pedal your bike on trails, to helping Chase think through his own thoughts about what it means to be a man, in Courier: Dragons Within, deep breaths are paramount.

  • Character-driven story: Follow Chase and Tag as they confront themselves, the wild, and their past. Uncover the meaning of "facing your dragon" as Chase confronts his own demons and sheds an undeserving masculinity.

  • Explore the Beauty of Big Sur: From its hills and redwoods to the beaches, catch a taste of the beautiful national park along your journey!

content_descriptors.notes: Audio depictions of parental emotional abuse
